description.text:
The first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game DP series, made for the Nintendo DS games Pokémon Diamond and Pearl. It came as two packs released together, Diamond Collection with Dialga on the wrapper and Pearl Collection with Palkia, and each had Pokémon found only in it. Both went on sale early at the Pokémon Diamond & Pearl Battle Festa 2006 on 25 November 2006 and in shops on 30 November, with 11 cards a pack, one of them holo. The DP series itself had begun on 27 October 2006, and the product page suggests using these cards to strengthen its ready-made starter decks. In English the set became Diamond & Pearl in May 2007.

The DP series changed the cards in several ways. It brought Pokémon LV.X, which level up the Active Pokémon while it keeps its earlier attacks and powers, starting here with Torterra, Infernape and Empoleon LV.X. Cards once again showed the Pokémon's level and a Pokédex entry, and Poison-type Pokémon from the games became Psychic instead of Grass.
